label: common_0300_man_a_01
text: Toma ya! It’s time for the great outdoors!

label: common_0300_woman_a_01
text: Come on, Cyclizar! We’re riding out!

label: common_0300_head_teacher_01
text: Take care, everyone! And remember—the Great\nCrater of Paldea is exceedingly dangerous!\r\nEntering it is a violation of school rules![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0300_head_teacher_02
text: Hmm. Do you think everyone heard my warning?\c\nWith the students so full of vim and vigor, I find it\nhard not to worry.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0300_man_b_01
text: When you’re told you can do anything at all,\nit sort of makes it harder to know where to start...

label: common_0300_man_c_01
text: The Treasure Hunt—I’ve been waiting for this!\c\nI’m gonna take the best photos ever with the\nnew camera I spent all my pocket money on!

label: common_0300_man_d_01
text: To me, treasure hunting means catching Pokémon!\nI’m going to fill up my Pokédex for sure!

label: common_0300_woman_b_01
text: Where should I go? I wish someone else would\njust decide for me...

label: common_0300_woman_c_01
text: I’m gonna take my Pokémon picnicking in all the\nbest spots around the region!
